class.name: NetwPersistenceConfig
class.description:
The record includes properties configured with [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] on the root and its children. [codeblock] @export var account_id: StringName
func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").persisted(&"where") Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .table(&"players") \ .record_id(account_name) \ .interval(5.0)
func account_name() -> StringName: return account_id [/codeblock] [method record_id] must return an id that stays the same between sessions. Peer ids change when players rejoin. [member NetwEntity.persistence] reaches the saved record. [b]Record layout[/b] Changes to saved names or types require [method migrate]. Renaming a property while keeping its saved name needs no migration. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"coins").persisted(&"gold") Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .table(&"players") \ .storage_version(2) \ .migrate(1, add_gold) \ .record_id(account_name)
func add_gold(values: Dictionary) -> Dictionary: values[&"gold"] = 0 return values [/codeblock]

method.name: database
method.description: Names the [NetwDatabase] this [NetwEntity]'s record lives in, as [method Netw.configure_database] declared it.

method.name: interval
method.description: Saves only when a property changed. [code]0.0[/code] saves only through [method NetwPersistence.save]. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: load_on_spawn
method.description: Whether the server loads the stored record when the [NetwEntity]'s node is ready. Clients do not receive the [NetwEntity] until the load succeeds or finds no record. Call [method NetwPersistence.load] to retry a failed load.

method.name: migrate
method.description:
Upgrades saved data from [param from_version] to the next version. A load calls [param step] for each version up to [method storage_version]. Return all properties needed by the next version. [codeblock lang=text] step(values: Dictionary) -> Dictionary
Dictionary ┖╴saved property name Variant the value stored under that name [/codeblock]

method.name: record_id
method.description: Calls [param provider] once when the root is ready. Its nonempty [StringName] identifies the record across sessions.

method.name: storage_version
method.description: The version of saved data, starting at [code]1[/code]. Raise it when saved properties change, and add a [method migrate] step from the previous version.

method.name: table
method.description: Roots using the same [param name] must declare the same saved property names, types and [method storage_version].
